Provenance and boundaries

How this index was built

Every number on this page is generated from the catalogue, not typed into existence and hoped at.

01

First-party catalogue

The official Too Jewish archive supplied broadcast dates, named guests, descriptions, and listed MP3 links from August 2002 onward.

Open official archive ↗
02

Podcast cross-check

Podbean episode pages supplied an independent first-party match for 736 broadcasts, including durable episode pages and published runtimes.

Open podcast archive ↗
03

Link verification

All 1,219 listed MP3 URLs were tested. A network error is never silently labelled dead; only a confirmed missing response enters the gap count.

04

Evidence boundary

Published descriptions support discovery, not quotation or claim analysis. Transcript reviews, thematic synthesis, and evidence maps will be added only after source-level work.
